[NGST.1.3] The `dsc` compiler ([NGST.4]). `dsc` turns `.ds` source into the
`.dsc` artefact that `ds_engine_load_dsc` consumes. Every schema reaches an
engine from such an artefact ([NFCT.1.1]), so an integrator needs `dsc`, or an
artefact `dsc` built, even for a program that declares schemas and no rules.
